name: Cosmident AI
statusLine: Live · onboarding our first partner academies
summary: AI mock exams for the UK dental registration exams, run under an academy's own brand, with a spoken AI patient and a mark sheet with evidence the moment a candidate finishes.

mark.alt: Cosmident AI logo: a gradient C with a tooth and an orbit

title: The mock exam,
reinvented.
hero.lede: AI mock exams for the UK dental registration exams, under your academy's brand. Candidates sit a timed circuit, talk to an AI patient and get a mark sheet with evidence the moment they finish.

cards.title: No feedback from the regulator
cards.body: Failing candidates get no marks, no mark sheets and no model answers.

cards.title: Mocks that don't scale
cards.body: Actors, a venue and senior examiners, all on one fixed day.

cards.title: A spoken exam, rehearsed alone
cards.body: The exam is timed and spoken. Most practice happens from books.

steps.title: Written and drawing stations
steps.body: Forms, prescriptions, tooth diagrams and radiograph marking, on a clock the server keeps.

steps.title: The AI patient
steps.body: A spoken consultation. The patient reveals only what the candidate asks for.

steps.title: The long case
steps.body: 54 minutes in four locked phases. New results release as the case unfolds.

steps.title: Medical emergencies viva
steps.body: An AI examiner asks 15 questions in 8 minutes, and probes when an answer falls short.

steps.title: The mark sheet
steps.body: Instant, criterion by criterion, with the candidate's own words as evidence.

demo.label: Product demo
title: Watch a sitting
in action.
demo.play: Play the Cosmident AI product demo

audit.label: Marking you can audit
title: No black box.
Every mark shows its evidence.
points: Every criterion quotes the candidate's own words
The platform adds up the totals, never the AI
A safety-critical miss fails the station
Uncertain attempts go to a human

human.label: Examiner review
title: Humans keep
the final word.
human.body: Academy examiners can review any attempt, read the transcript and the AI's reasoning, and override any score.

academy.label: Built for academies
title: Your brand.
Our engine.
items: Your name and colours on the platform your candidates use.
Load your own stations, rubrics and model answers.
Set the station mix, timing and pass marks.
Embed it on your own site with a small widget.

how.label: How it works
title: From onboarding
to the next attempt.
steps: The academy is onboarded with its brand, questions and rubrics
Candidates pick a station, the circuit, the long case, the viva or a full mock
They sit it under real timing, by voice or by typing
A mark sheet, debrief and training plan arrive instantly
Progress shows what to practise next, with unlimited attempts

disclaimer: Independent mock preparation for the GDC ORE Part 2. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the GDC. Scores are indicative and do not predict the official result.

close.label: Book a demo
title: Mock exams
that run themselves.
close.body: Bring Cosmident AI to your academy, under your own brand.

hero.alt: Cosmident AI during a spoken consultation: the AI patient avatar on a video call beside a live transcript of the conversation.

sitting.alt: A radiograph station: two findings boxed on a panoramic radiograph, with zoom and contrast tools and the list of marked findings.
The AI patient station: the patient avatar answers out loud while the conversation is transcribed.
The long case: history and examination done, with new investigation results released for the current phase.
The debrief: a pass verdict, each component scored against the pass mark, and the path through the circuit.

audit.alt: The full mark sheet: every criterion marked correct or missed, then the top fixes, each quoting what the candidate said and a better line to say next time.

human.alt: The examiner review queue: the candidate's transcript, the rubric with critical criteria and notes, and buttons to approve or override the marks.
